Find dedicated players, desktop installers, Enigma plugins, web access and downloader codes. For Android TV and Android boxes, we recommend the server’s own app with username and password activation created through the M3U function.

BEFORE INSTALLING

Match the player to your device.

Windows 10 and Windows 11 use different installers. macOS uses the DMG package. Android TV and boxes use APK files or downloader codes. Linux receivers use the Enigma plugin.

Security note: Download only on the intended device. Some supplied download URLs use HTTP rather than HTTPS; your browser may show a warning. Verify the filename with support before running an installer.
